diagnosis: CSPViolationRecordDetailView exposes stored Content Security Policy violation records containing document_uri, blocked_uri, and script-sample data. The lookup query CSPViolationRecord.objects.all() omits organization scoping. Because browser CSP reports frequently log document URIs containing password reset tokens, OAuth state codes, and private query parameters, any authenticated tenant can harvest credentials of other tenants.

corrected_code:
from rest_framework import generics, permissions
from .models import CSPViolationRecord
from .serializers import CSPViolationRecordSerializer

class CSPViolationRecordDetailView(generics.RetrieveAPIView):
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]
    serializer_class = CSPViolationRecordSerializer
    queryset = CSPViolationRecord.objects.all()

    def get_object(self):
        report_id = self.kwargs.get("pk")
        # Scope CSP report lookup strictly to requesting user's organization
        return generics.get_object_or_404(
            self.queryset.filter(organization=self.request.user.organization),
            pk=report_id
        )
